answer: Sybil resistance here uses a staking spiral: each new identity must burn a small ember of locked tokens that decays unless the identity performs real work, and every peer signs a unique cipher challenge tied to that stake. Duplicating identities means paying the burn repeatedly while the decaying ember never recovers, so attackers face rising per-identity cost that quickly exceeds any reward from fake accounts.
